title: VirtualPyTest in 60 seconds: automated testing for TV, STB, mobile and web
description:
Any device with a screen, tested and monitored 24/7. VirtualPyTest drives real set-top boxes, TVs, phones and web apps, proves what is on screen, and watches every device around the clock.

In this minute: one dashboard for every host and device, live stream and remote control of real hardware, one-click test runs, reports with screenshots and video, KPI measurement, the 24h heatmap and incident evidence.

Open source and free. Run it on a Raspberry Pi in your lab or on a server in the cloud.
